notes: Extracted 29 October 2026 from the guide (src/guides/summarytile.guide.tsx) and docs/evidence/summarytile.md at 52bf96e (“docs: add Summary Tile guide”, 20 October), the same files on main and docs-next. The guide's Sources note and the evidence were checked on 20 October 2026 on mirror v0.1.78-c7d3348 (Biscuit's main at c7d3348, the 19 October build), so items citing them carry 2026-10-20 and 0.1.78-c7d3348. Installed build: jfs-components 0.1.78, mirror v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (Biscuit's main at dbe0e02, 27 October). GitHub's compare of v0.1.78-c7d3348 and v0.1.78-dbe0e02 (195 files, complete) changes SummaryTile (src, lib and its .d.ts) and none of what it renders or reads: no StrengthIndicator, NavArrow or Button file, no design-tokens or resolver file, no react-utils or typography util. The SummaryTile change looks like Biscuit's work for #352 (the evidence's Component Bug: placeholder action, slot Button look, accessible name, disableTruncation scope), which isn't in the 28 October docs publish (e7ed622's fix list has no #352), so the guide still describes c7d3348. Read from the installed source (SummaryTile.tsx), not rendered: children left out shows no action at all, unless onActionPress is set, which renders the built-in Button labelled actionLabel (“Button” by default) with that handler (177–188); onPress suppresses that built-in Button but still renders children (180, 178–179); a child in children is cloned with { AppearanceBrand: 'Secondary', 'Button / Size': 'S', ...tile modes } and its own modes on top (26–29, 175, 179; cloneChildrenWithModes in react-utils), so a bare Button is purple and size S with no modes on the tile; the description now takes the same one-line clamp as the title, and disableTruncation lifts both (209–232, resolveTruncation(disableTruncation, 1)); the spoken name is accessibilityLabel ?? title, on the row button with onPress and, without it, a web group (role group, aria-label) or the native accessibilityLabel (258–286). Unchanged and matching the guide: title 16 px bold, description 12 px, gaps 8 and 4, padding 0, width 100%, row centred (121–154, 250–256; tokens resolved through getVariableByName on dbe0e02 have one value in every mode tried: no modes, AppearanceBrand Secondary and Neutral, Emphasis Low, Semantic Intent System with AppearanceSystem negative, and Color Mode Dark); the title line is max(18, ceil(16 × 1.2)) = 20 (safeTextLineHeight); the meter is a StrengthIndicator (role image, “Strength indicator: <Level> confidence”, floats bucketed at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6) and null removes it (172, 217–222); the chevron is NavArrow Forward after the action (246), and its colour doesn't change with AppearanceBrand, Emphasis or Semantic Intent either; onPress wraps the row in a Pressable with role button that dims to 0.7 (260–275); there is no disabled, selected or loading prop. So the guide sentences dbe0e02 contradicts are not recorded: the placeholder Button when children is left out (Configuration's “Left out, the tile shows a placeholder Button with no onPress, so …”, States' “it removes the placeholder Button, not one you pass”, the Your own Button / The placeholder pair, Sources' default action, the playground readout); setting AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S on the tile to make a Button purple and small (Configuration's “Give the tile AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S, …”, the Modes on the tile / A bare Button pair, the Your Button card's “from the tile’s modes”, Sources); a description that wraps and never truncates (Anatomy's “it wraps”, Sizing's “so the description wraps onto more lines”, the Narrow host card, Content's “it never truncates, so a paragraph makes the row tall”); and Sources' “disableTruncation affects only the title, and a tile without onPress isn't announced by its title”. Their advice stays where the guide or the package gives it otherwise: children holds the action, the tile passes its modes, the Button's modes win (Configuration), and the package facts (children, actionLabel, onActionPress, disableTruncation, accessibilityLabel). A human flag in reviews/summarytile.json points at #352. Not recorded: the Emphasis Medium, Emphasis Low, AppearanceBrand Neutral and Semantic Intent System cards, which show mode values side by side with no guide sentence saying when to choose one (the guide's general sentence on what those collections change is kept); “Figma draws it at 280 px” and the 8 px and 4 px spacing (in the evidence facts, not advice); the guide's TILE modes, maxWidth 320 and host widths (docs frames); style, titleStyle and descriptionStyle (the building rules keep style overrides off Coin components); Storybook's 15 mode collections, of which only the action's change anything; Figma's layer list. avoidWhen: the guide names no case or component, so the two items come from the upstream Storybook docs as the evidence records them (Biscuit's handwritten SummaryTile.mdx: not for the block itself or two actions), as CardFeedback's do. Anatomy: Title and Description are marked always present because the package renders them by default (“Spending”, “Know your spending and savings”) and only an empty string removes them; the meter (confidence null), the action and the chevron are optional. Examples follow the building rules: no Color Mode, no tile modes (on dbe0e02 a slotted Button is purple and S by default, so the guide's TILE modes only repeat it), no Card AppearanceBrand Neutral (white is Card's default since #343), no VStack Slot gap, no style. The In context example keeps the guide's Card, tile, See all Button and three ListItems, with the guide's layout and navArrow props, and leaves out their MoneyValue amounts because MoneyValue has no entry in this pack. The chevron example leaves children out (on dbe0e02 that shows no action, and onPress would suppress the built-in one anyway), where the guide passes null for the c7d3348 placeholder. All components used have an entry. Content: good is the guide's Content copy; bad is “Button”, the built-in Button's label when actionLabel is left out (the guide's placeholder Don't shows the same word). Gaps: the published Storybook page (index.json last modified 17 October 2026, the stories the Sources note lists, rechecked 29 October) and the title's 20 px line against Figma's 18, which dbe0e02 keeps. The evidence's unread tokens (summaryTile/content/width, /height, /titleWrap/height) are left out as internal. Sorting (batch 11, rounds 1 and 2): two cross-check runs. Round 1 flagged /examples/0 and /examples/2 for dropping the guide’s TILE modes (and the Bills example’s Low meter, which is the guide’s own Content code, summarytile.guide.tsx line 112), and the modes evidence fact, whose description said modes “reach the action, the meter and the chevron”: our wording, not the evidence’s, so it now ends at “No mode changes them.”; the example purposes now say why the tile carries no modes. Round 2, on the final entry, flagged /examples/0 and /examples/2 again (the guide says a passed Button is gold and size M) and /anatomy/2 (the quote is cut before “; it wraps.”); all three are dismissed in reviews/summarytile.json, because the reviewer reads the c7d3348 guide and evidence and can’t see the installed dbe0e02 source (SummaryTile.tsx 26–29, 175, 179, 225–229). Its notes, not flags: the type facts (actionLabel, onActionPress, children, disableTruncation, accessibilityLabel) contradict the guide and evidence and look like a newer build: they are the installed 0.1.78-dbe0e02, which is what the human flag says; the dropped Modes on the tile and Your own Button pairs are the stale ones. No trace-check flags remain; the human flag (#352) is the only one. Ticket (coordinator, batch 11): the guide fix belongs to #352 (Component Fix, open; items 3 and 7 left), whose publish re-checks the guide; a work note on #352 lists the sentences above. Fix loop (release 0.1.78+22, 31 October, for Astra’s review of +14): /configuration/2 and /3 now name both conditions for the built-in Button, children left out and no onPress on the tile (SummaryTile.tsx 174, 178–188: a pressable tile suppresses it, as the onPress fact says); /configuration/12 adds chevron left off, which its scope reason already named (246). Astra confirmed the /examples/0, /examples/2 and /anatomy/2 dismissals; the #352 flag stays. The fresh cross-check of the fixed entry flagged /anatomy/0 and, under the wrong pointer, the Description part as always present; our misreading, fixed: Title and Description are optional parts, since the tile draws each only when its text is not empty (SummaryTile.tsx 209, 225; the evidence: “Empty `title` or `description` removes that text.”), and left out each shows its sample (title “Spending”, description “Know your spending and savings”).

configuration.text: There is no default action: pass a Button or an IconButton in children, or use actionLabel and onActionPress for the built-in small secondary Button.

onActionPress, with children left out and no onPress on the tile, renders the built-in small secondary Button with that handler instead of a dead placeholder; a tile with onPress has no built-in Button.

actionLabel labels the built-in Button only when children is left out, onActionPress is set and the tile has no onPress; without actionLabel the Button reads “Button”, and actionLabel on its own renders no button.
The tile passes its modes to whatever you put there, and your Button’s own modes win.

from.quote: The tile passes its modes to whatever you put there, and your Button’s own modes win.

configuration.text: A Button or IconButton in children starts at AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S; modes on the tile override those defaults, and the child’s own modes override the tile.

examples.purpose: Spending on the Money screen, the guide’s In context: the tile heads a card and the list under it is the block it introduces. See all does the work through its own onPress (the empty handler stands for opening the screen’s spending view). The tile carries no modes: on the installed package a Button in children starts at AppearanceBrand Secondary and Button / Size S. The guide’s MoneyValue amounts are left out because MoneyValue has no entry in this pack.
